title: What If You Nuked A Volcano?

lines.text: If you dropped a nuke into a volcano, it wouldn't even sink.
Lava is almost three times denser than water, so the bomb would float.
At eleven hundred degrees, its wiring fries and its explosives burn unevenly.
And a nuke only works if they all fire at once.
So, no mushroom cloud. Just a radioactive mess.
But lower it miles down into the magma chamber, and the blast could crack the rock above.
If it erupts, that's not the bomb's power. It's the volcano's.
